Definition: from G680; probably a ligament (as fastening):--joint.
BiblicalUsage: A joint is where the parts of a body fasten together, and Paul uses the picture for the church. In Ephesians 4:16 the whole body is fitly joined together by every joint that supplies strength, and in Colossians 2:19 the body grows from the Head through the joints and bands.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the joints are the ordinary believers holding the body together, and the body only grows when they do their quiet work.
